facts.statement: Gasosaurus lived during the Middle Jurassic, between approximately 171.6 and 161.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Gasosaurus () is a genus of tetanuran theropod that lived approximately 171.6 to 161.2 million years ago during the middle of the Jurassic Period.

facts.statement: The name Gasosaurus combines the English word 'gasoline' with the Greek word for 'lizard'.
facts.quote: The name "Gasosaurus" is derived from the English "gasoline" and the Greek σαῦρος (sauros) ("lizard / generic reptile").

facts.statement: The species name 'constructus' honors the gasoline company that discovered the fossils at the Dashanpu quarry in Sichuan, China.
facts.quote: Only one species is currently recognised, G. constructus, from which the specific name honours the gasoline company that found the Dashanpu fossil quarry in Sichuan Province, China, now named as the Lower Shaximiao Formation.

facts.statement: Paleontologists Dong Zhiming and Tang Zilu defined the fossils as the type species Gasosaurus constructus.
facts.quote: The fossils were defined as the type species Gasosaurus constructus by the paleontologists Dong Zhiming and Tang Zilu.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus was a carnivorous theropod characterized by strong legs and short arms.
facts.quote: Gasosaurus is a carnivorous theropod with strong legs but short arms.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus measured between 3.5 and 4 meters in length and weighed around 150 kilograms.
facts.quote: It measured between 3.5 to 4 m in length, with a weight of around 150 kg.

facts.statement: Some estimates suggest Gasosaurus could have weighed as much as 400 kilograms, though this is uncertain due to limited fossil evidence.
facts.quote: However, some estimates put its weight as high as 400 kg, as very little is known about it.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus is recognized by features including amphiplatyan cervical and dorsal centra, low neural arches, plate-like neural spines, a humeral foramen, and expanded distal ends of the pubis and ischium.
facts.quote: Furthermore, it is recognized by an amphiplatyan cervical centra with incipient weak ventral keel, dorsals with amphiplatyan centra, low neural arches and plate-like neural spines, dorsal neural spines lacking expanded bulks at tips, five sacral centra and arches firmly fused while neural spines not fused, presence of a humeral foramen, low ilium with a less developed anterior process, and distal ends of pubis and ischium expanded but lacking foot-like processes.

facts.statement: Holtz (2000) classified Gasosaurus as a basal coelurosaurian, while later Holtz et al. (2004) suggested it might be a basal carnosaur or metriacanthosaurid.
facts.quote: Traditionally thought to be a megalosauroid, Holtz (2000) found it to be a basal coelurosaurian, although later Holtz et al. (2004) suggested it was a basal carnosaur (possibly a metriacanthosaurid) on the basis of data from undescribed specimens.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus may represent the most basal known coelurosaurian or be close to the common ancestor of coelurosaurs and non-coelurosaurs, making it one of the oldest definitive tetanuran theropods.
facts.quote: It may in fact be the most basal coelurosaurian yet known, or may even be close to the common ancestor of the two groups; in any case, it represents one of the oldest definitive tetanuran theropods.

facts.statement: Due to fragmentary fossils, Gasosaurus has an uncertain position within Tetanurae but is likely outside Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: Because of the fragmentary nature of the known Gasosaurus fossils, it has an uncertain position within Tetanurae, but probably lays outside Coelurosauria.

facts.statement: Some paleontologists speculate that Gasosaurus and Kaijiangosaurus might be the same species.
facts.quote: Some paleontologists have speculated that Gasosaurus and Kaijiangosaurus may be one and the same species.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus lived approximately 164 million years ago during the Bathonian and Callovian stages of the Middle Jurassic in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: Gasosaurus constructus ("lagarto encontrado en la construcción de una estación de gas") Gasosaurus de dinosaurio terópodo tetanuro, que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 164 millones, en el Bathoniense y el Calloviense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus had short, strong legs and short arms.
facts.quote: Gasosaurus tiene piernas cortas y fuertes pero también brazos cortos.

facts.statement: The humerus of the holotype measures 237 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: El húmero del holotipo tiene una longitud de 237 milímetros.

facts.statement: The tibia is clearly shorter than the femur, measuring less than 370 millimeters compared to the femur's 425 millimeters, which is a primitive characteristic.
facts.quote: La tibia es claramente más corta de 370 milímetros que el fémur de 425 milímetros de largo, que es una característica básica.

facts.statement: The first fossil is a postcranial skeleton with no known skull remains, cataloged as IVPP V7264.
facts.quote: El primer fósil es un esqueleto postcranial, no se conocen restos del cráneo, recobrado en 1985 durante la construcción de una gasolinera, es lo único que se conoce fue catalogado como IVPP V7264.

facts.statement: The name was assigned in honor of the oil company that found it at Dashanpu during a gas excavation in Sichuan Province, China, in the Lower Shaximiao Formation.
facts.quote: El nombre fue asignado en honor a la empresa petrolera que lo encontró en Dashanpu durante una excavación gasífera, provincia de Sichuan, China, en la Formación Xiashaximiao.

facts.statement: Fossils of Gasosaurus were excavated near Dashanpu in Sichuan province, China.
facts.quote: miniaturadeimagen|Espécimen fósil de Gasosaurus excavado cerca de Dashanpu, provincia de Sichuan (China).

facts.statement: Gasosaurus lived during the middle Jurassic period, approximately 164 million years ago.
facts.quote: Vivió a mediados del periodo Jurásico (hace 164 millones de años).

facts.statement: In 2000, Holtz classified Gasosaurus as a basal coelurosaurian, but later suggested in 2004 that it was a basal carnosaurian, possibly a sinraptorid.
facts.quote: En el 2000 Holtz encontró que era un coelurosaurio basal, aunque después el mismo Holtz et al. en 2004 sugirió que era un carnosaurio basal, posiblemente un sinraptoride sobre la base de datos de especímenes no descritos.

facts.statement: In 2004, Holtz placed Gasosaurus within the broader group Avetheropoda.
facts.quote: En 2004 colocó a Gasosaurus en la más inclusiva Avetheropoda.

facts.statement: Due to the fragmentary nature of known fossils, Gasosaurus has an uncertain position within Tetanurae and is likely outside Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: Debido a la naturaleza fragmentaria de los fósiles conocidos de Gasosaurus, tiene una posición incierta dentro de Tetanurae y probablemente se encuentra fuera de Coelurosauria.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus represents one of the oldest definitive tetanuran theropods.
facts.quote: En cualquier caso, representa uno de los terópodos tetanuros definitivos más antiguos.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus lived during the middle Jurassic between the Bathonian and Callovian stages, around 164 million years ago.
facts.quote: Gasosarurus vivió durante mediados del periodo Jurásico entre Bathoniense y el Callovienses, alrededor de hace 164 millones de años.

facts.statement: Gasosaurus coexisted with other medium-sized theropods like Chuandongocoelurus and Kaijiangosaurus found in the Lower Shaximiao Formation.
facts.quote: Coexistió con otros terópodos de rango medio como Chuandongocoelurus y Kaijiangosaurus , otros dos dinosaurios encontrados en la formación Bajo Shaximiao .

facts.statement: Gasosaurus coexisted with sauropods such as Datousaurus, Omeisaurus, and Protognathosaurus.
facts.quote: También convivió con sauropodos como Datousaurus, Omeisaurus y Protognathosaurus .

facts.statement: Smaller herbivorous dinosaurs like Xiaosaurus, Agilisaurus, and Huayangosaurus were present and served as prey.
facts.quote: Además, también estaban los dinosaurios herbívoros más pequeños, Xiaosaurus Agilisaurus y Huayangosaurus, que fueron una presa adecuada.

facts.statement: China possesses the greatest diversity of Middle Jurassic theropods across all body sizes of any region in the world.
facts.quote: China, cuenta con la mayor diversidad de terópodos del Jurásico Medio de todos los tamaños de cuerpos que cualquier parte del mundo.

facts.statement: The parent group of the genus Gasosaurus is Tetanurae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Tetanurae

facts.statement: Gasosaurus is classified under the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

facts.statement: The time range for Gasosaurus is from the Bajocian to the Oxfordian, spanning 170.9 to 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago)

rejected.quote: The first and to date only fossils, albeit postcranial (missing the skull), were recovered in 1985 during the construction of a gas facility, which explains the dinosaur's unusual name.
